name: sentry_update_issue
description: Update a single Sentry issue. Provide the numeric `issue_id` (the `id` field from sentry_list_issues). Set `status` to `resolved`, `ignored`, or `unresolved`, and/or reassign with `assignedTo` (a user identifier like `username@example.com`, `user:<id>`, or `team:<id>`; pass an empty string to unassign). Only the fields you provide are changed. This mutates real Sentry data — confirm the target with the user first unless they clearly asked for it.

issue_id.description: The issue's numeric id (the `id` field from sentry_list_issues).

assignedTo.description: Optional new assignee, e.g. `username@example.com`, `user:<id>`, or `team:<id>`. Empty string unassigns.
